description: This file contains the implementation of YOLOv3 object detection model in TensorFlow/Keras, including custom layers, model architectures, and training components.

classes.name: YoloLayer
classes.description: Custom Keras layer implementing YOLO loss and prediction adjustments for object detection.

methods.name: dummy_loss(y_true, y_pred)
methods.description: A placeholder loss function that computes the square root of the sum of predictions. Used as a dummy loss during model training.

methods.name: NetworkConv2D_BN_Leaky(input, channels, kernel_size, kernel_regularizer = l2(5e-4), strides=(1,1), padding="same", use_bias=False)
methods.description: Constructs a Conv2D layer followed by BatchNormalization and LeakyReLU activation.

methods.name: residual_block(input, channels, num_blocks)
methods.description: Creates a residual block with multiple convolutional layers with skip connections.

methods.name: darknet(input)
methods.description: Defines the Darknet-53 backbone for YOLO, composed of residual blocks.

methods.name: last_layers(input, channels_in, channels_out, layer_name="")
methods.description: Creates the last convolutional layers used in the YOLO head, including upsampling and concatenation.

methods.name: yolov3_base(input, num_anchors, num_classes)
methods.description: Builds the core YOLOv3 architecture, generating three detection scales.

methods.name: yolov3_main(input, num_anchors, num_classes)
methods.description: Constructs the full YOLOv3 model with input and output layers for training.

methods.name: yolov3_train(num_classes, anchors, max_box_per_image, max_grid, batch_size, warmup_batches, ignore_thresh, grid_scales, obj_scale, noobj_scale, xywh_scale, class_scale)
methods.description: Assembles the YOLOv3 training model with loss calculations for different prediction scales, parameters for training configuration included.

methods.name: tiny_yolov3_main(input, num_anchors, num_classes)
methods.description: Builds a smaller, lightweight YOLOv3 model suitable for less powerful devices.
